payload.findingText:
RV-001 [test-writer] room-booking-api:INV-005.statement: every response with a body carries the header Content-Type with the value application/json; tests/errors/errors.test.ts:80-86 checks a constant and response values, not an actual response header
RV-002 [test-writer] room-booking-api:INV-004.negative_cases: a room_busy response without conflictingBookingId violates the rule; tests/errors/errors.test.ts:73-77 requires errorResponse(apiError(code)) to return for room_busy without an ID
RV-003 [implementer] room-booking-api:POL-001.predicate: a room_busy failure additionally names conflictingBookingId; src/errors/index.ts:40-56 emits a room_busy error response without that field when the optional ID is omitted

RV-001 [test-writer] room-booking-api:INV-003.test_obligation.predicate: no two stored bookings of one room have overlapping half-open intervals; tests/core/store.test.ts:94: nested test checks a conflict lookup but never attempts to store the conflicting booking
RV-002 [implementer] room-booking-api:INV-003.statement: at every point in time, the booking intervals of the bookings of one room never overlap; src/core/index.ts:98: addBooking unconditionally appends the supplied interval

RV-001 [implementer] room-booking-api:BEH-019.when: attendees that is not an integer; room-booking-api:CTR-006.schema.query: attendees as an integer; src/routes/availability/index.ts:22-23: Number conversion rounds fractions and overflows large integers before validation

RV-001 [test-writer] room-booking-api:BEH-016.then: POST for the same interval succeeds with 201; room-booking-api:SCN-001.observable_sequence: the second POST returns 201 with booking id b2; tests/routes/booking-query/booking-query.test.ts:186-188,322-323: rebooking calls store.addBooking directly and never asserts a POST response

RV-001 [implementer] room-booking-api:BEH-002.negative_cases: name of 40 characters => 201 with the created room; src/routes/rooms/index.ts:19: JavaScript UTF-16 length rejects 40 supplementary-plane characters as length 80

RV-001 [test-writer] room-booking-api:SCN-002.observable_sequence: GET /rooms/r2/bookings returns a bookings array holding b2 only; tests/routes/booking-create/booking-create.test.ts:344: checks store.listBookings through ids instead of issuing or asserting a GET response

RV-001 [contract] room-booking-api:BEH-020.test_obligation.predicate: a path that no endpoint declares returns 404 with error not_found for every method; src/server/index.ts:79: HEAD responses are sent through node:http, which suppresses response bodies
RV-002 [test-writer] room-booking-api:CON-001.test_obligation.predicate: the test suite passes with all outbound network access blocked; tests/server/server.test.ts:263: the marked test serves requests without blocking or detecting outbound network access
RV-003 [test-writer] room-booking-api:SCN-003.trigger: the process is stopped and a new process is started on the same port; tests/server/server.test.ts:219: both marked restart tests close and reopen servers in the same process
RV-004 [implementer] room-booking-api:CTR-007.compatibility_rules: a request carrying a body that is not valid JSON is answered invalid_json before the path or method is resolved; src/server/index.ts:95: readBody uses replacement UTF-8 decoding before JSON parsing
